description: In the OpenCAD system (http://localhost), log in as admin (admin@opencad.local / Admin123!). After logging in you will see the main dashboard. Click the CIVILIAN button to access the Civilian Console. Click 'Add New Identity' to open the registration form. Fill in the following details: Name: 'Wade Hebert', Date of Birth: '1991-04-17', Address: '1432 Forum Drive, Davis', Sex: 'Male', Race: 'Caucasian', Hair Color: 'Brown', Build: 'Fit'. All dropdown fields (Sex, Race, Hair Color, Build, DL Status) are required by the form. Click Create to register the identity.
